7: 
8: - [x] 2.1 Update `src/output.js`: add `setJsonMode()` function, modify `success()` and `error()` to output plain text by default, JSON when `--json` is set
9: - [x] 2.2 Add global `--json` flag in `src/cli.js` on root program with `preAction` hook to call `setJsonMode()`
10: - [x] 2.3 Add plain text formatters for each command: `init`, `doctor`, `session` (start/stop/status), `step`, `screenshot`, `judge`, `note`, `fix`, `evidence`, `report`, `knowledge`
11: - [x] 2.4 Update all tests to account for plain text default (pass `--json` in tests that parse JSON output)
12: 
13: ## 3. Slim Config
14: 
15: - [x] 3.1 Update `src/config.js`: remove `simulator.pool_size`, `port_range`, `session.lock_dir` from DEFAULTS. Hardcode `LOCK_DIR = '.proofrun/locks'` as constant. Keep `session.evidence_dir`, `reports.*`
16: - [x] 3.2 Update `src/config.js` `validateConfig()`: remove pool_size and port_range validation

21: 
22: - [x] 4.1 Rewrite `src/locking.js`: replace pool-based allocation with named resource locking — `acquireLock(lockDir, resourceName)`, `releaseLock(lock)`, `listLocks(lockDir)`. Remove `ensureSimLockFiles`, `ensurePortLockFiles`, `acquireSimulatorSlot`, `acquirePort`
23: - [x] 4.2 Update `src/commands/session.js` `start`: accept `--simulator <UDID>` (required), lock by UDID, no port allocation. Session state stores simulator as UDID string only
24: - [x] 4.3 Update `src/commands/session.js` `stop`: release simulator lock by UDID
25: - [x] 4.4 Update `src/commands/session.js` `status`: show active session with simulator UDID, list locked resources
26: - [x] 4.5 Update `src/session.js` `findActiveSession()`: remove dev_server.pid check, active = status is 'active'
27: - [x] 4.6 Update `src/locking.test.js` and `src/session.test.js` for new locking model

34: - [x] 5.4 Update `src/commands/report.js` `buildReportData()`: group by criterion, use criterion name as section header
